units.takeaway: An open-weight LLM run inside the hospital extracted severity more accurately than a rule-based system and held its accuracy at a second centre.

units.takeaway: Valve disease registries depend on severity grades abstracted by hand from free-text reports.

units.takeaway: Rule-based extraction misses varied phrasing, and LLMs can read it.

units.takeaway: Proprietary models cannot be used where reports must stay inside the hospital, and transfer to a second centre is untested.

units.takeaway: We compared a locally run open-weight LLM with a rule-based system at two centres and classified the remaining errors.
